operators.name: channel_shuffle_cuda
semantics: Performs channel shuffle as in torch.nn.functional.native_channel_shuffle with the given groups.
For input shape (N, C, H, W) and groups=g, reshapes to (N, g, C/g, H, W), transposes dimensions 1 and 2, then reshapes back to (N, C, H, W).
Returns a contiguous tensor with same values, preserving row-major order of the shuffled channels.
The operation assumes C is divisible by g.
Applies native channel shuffle with groups=2 to input tensor x of shape [512, 32, 128, 128] on CUDA.
Equivalent to reshape to [512, 2, 16, 128, 128], transpose(1,2), then reshape to [512, 32, 128, 128].
Returns the shuffled tensor, which is identical to the value at step_001.
